_readme: One place for every share card, favicon and theme-color tag. Swap files in public/ (and public/suomi/), bump `version` (e.g. 3) so X/WhatsApp/iMessage refetch, then build + deploy. index.html's <!-- share:begin/end --> block and the /suomi page are both rendered from this file.
